# How many compatibility problems the Plugin Verifier currently reports for each
# IDE, and therefore how many the Marketplace will show against the plugin page.
#
# verify.yml fails when a number goes up and tells you when one goes down. The
# target for every line is 0: that is what "green on the Marketplace" means.
#
# IU is IntelliJ IDEA, which ships the Java and TestNG plugins, so it is already
# there. The other three do not ship them, and every problem they report is an
# unresolved com.intellij.psi.* or com.theoryinpractice.testng.* class in the
# 38 files that need one. plugin.xml depends on both optionally and OptionalPlugin
# guards the code at runtime, but the verifier reads bytecode and cannot see a
# runtime guard - so the reports stand until that code moves into content
# modules of its own (#144).
#
# Lower a number here the moment the work lowers it, or the gate stops meaning
# anything.
IU 0
PY 53
GO 53
WS 53
